_comment: Benign text from domains where keyword NSFW rules misfire: medicine and sexual health, biology, security research, developer operations, and history / news. Written for the NSFW-default FP measurement (scripts/measure-content-defaults.mjs); every row is benign. Not a locked split: it prices the default, it does not tune a detector.

samples.text: Patients with a history of sexually transmitted infections should be screened annually; discuss sexual health openly and without judgement.
